name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell at each side.
Step one foot straight back, landing lightly on the ball of that foot.
Bend both knees to lower your hips until your rear knee approaches the floor.
Drive through your front foot to stand tall again and alternate the stepping leg.
tips: Keep your front heel planted and front knee tracking over your toes.
Keep your chest upright and step back with enough width for steady balance.
